data.name: Kiccha
data.gender_notes: Kiccha is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'kicchati' meaning 'to defy', 'to oppose'. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with powerful and defiant characters. For instance, Kiccha from the Mahabharata is a fierce and unyielding warrior. The name Kiccha carries the meaning “Victorious or Defiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kiccha usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious or defiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
